narrative.northStar: uBlock Origin's layout in T3 Code's skin and motion
keyCharacteristics: One dominant power control per page
Zinc neutrals, indigo primary, true-black dark mode
T3 motion: eased enters, drawer toasts, stepped pings
dos: Respect reduced motion and forced colors
donts: No decorative gradients or uppercase display type
No continuous animation except live status and in-flight work
